headlineFinding: All 114 families partition as metadata_only. Every discovered field or anchor already carries a terminal disposition, so regeneration adds the two counters and deterministic schema metadata and nothing else. There is no substantive classification drift anywhere in the corpus and no family is blocked on a missing census.
